title: MUBENCH: Assessment of Multilingual Capabilities of Large Language Models Across 61 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (accuracy and cross-lingual consistency) across 61 languages to measure disparities between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages, including robustness tests in mixed-language contexts.

Using GPT-4o and human annotators to identify and flag test samples containing Western-centric assumptions, region-specific knowledge, or obscure cultural references that do not translate equivalently across cultures.
